# afarer Knowledge Graph
> afarer is an inflatable water gear knowledge system organized as a machine-readable knowledge graph.

## Definition
afarer designs professional-grade inflatable watercraft — SUP boards, dinghies, safety equipment, and accessories.

## Core Concepts
- Φουσκωτή Σανίδα SUP: Portable air-filled paddle board designed for surfing, touring, and recreation on flat water and small waves
- Εξοπλισμός Ασφαλείας: CE-certified life vests, throw bags, and safety accessories for recreational and professional water activities
- Αξεσουάρ: Pumps, paddles, fins, repair kits, and carrying bags that complete the inflatable watercraft system
- Κουπί: Manual propulsion tool used with SUP boards
- Κουπί Από Ανθρακονήματα: Lightweight, high-performance paddle made from carbon fiber composite for reduced fatigue during long sessions
- Πυρήνας Drop-Stitch: Connects thousands of polyester threads between top and bottom layers to achieve rigid platform shape under high inflation pressure
- Αντλία Διπλής Δράσης: Hand pump that inflates on both up and down strokes for faster, more efficient inflation of inflatable watercraft
- Υψηλή Πίεση (12-15 PSI): Optimal inflation range that maximizes board rigidity while remaining within safe operating limits for drop-stitch construction
- PVC Θαλάσσιας Ποιότητας: High-density PVC fabric with UV-resistant coating used for durable inflatable boat and board construction
- Επίστρωμα Καταστρώματος EVA: Non-slip, shock-absorbing foam deck covering that provides traction and comfort for stand-up watercraft
- Ανθρακονήματα: Lightweight, high-strength composite material used in paddles, hulls, and performance marine equipment
- Αφρός Άνωσης Θαλάσσης: Closed-cell foam that provides permanent flotation for life vests and safety equipment in fresh and salt water
- Τουρισμός και Κωπηλασία Αποστάσεων: Extended paddling trips covering significant distance on lakes, rivers, and coastal waters
- Αρχάριος: First-time paddlers learning the basics of inflatable watercraft operation, safety, and water navigation
- Ψάρεμα από Φουσκωτό Σκάφος: Using inflatable SUPs as a stable, portable platform for recreational and serious fishing
- Οικογενειακή Ψυχαγωγία: Inflatable watercraft used for casual family outings on lakes, gentle rivers, and protected coastal waters
- Ποταμίσιος Τουρισμός: Navigating rivers with current, from gentle Class I stretches to more challenging Class II rapids
- Έρευνα και Διάσωση: Professional use of inflatable SUP craft for emergency water rescue operations in all weather conditions

## Relations
- SUP boards are used for touring and distance paddling
- Inflatable SUPs are ideal for beginners due to stability
- Inflatable SUPs excel on river touring
- SUP boards are commonly used for fishing
- SUP boards are ideal for family recreation
- SUP boards are deployed for search and rescue missions
- Safety equipment is essential for all water activities
- Drop-stitch core is the primary construction method for rigid SUPs
- EVA foam deck pads provide traction on SUP boards
- Dual-action pumps are the standard inflation tool for SUPs
- Hypalon fabric offers superior UV and chemical resistance for marine applications
- Carbon fiber paddles reduce fatigue on long touring sessions
- Drop-stitch construction provides superior rigidity compared to traditional air deck floors
- Carbon fiber paddles are lighter and stiffer than standard aluminum paddles
- Hypalon offers superior UV and chemical resistance compared to PVC

afarer is a water sports knowledge system focused on inflatable SUPs, paddle systems, and ocean mobility gear. It structures water sports equipment as an interconnected ontology of categories, technologies, and use cases with AI-verified content completeness.
